name: Spotlight Promo
tagline: Spotlight's premium social ad: footage first, short captions low over a scrim, one gold accent.

motion.direction: Spotlight promo. Footage first: at most one graphic at a time, low in the free zone, 2–5 words per line in sentence case with a small uppercase kicker above (`kicker` font, letter-spaced) and the headline below. Each line fades in with a short rise, holds 0.3 s per word (never under 1 s), fades out. A `counter` for any exact number with a source-like label; a numbered `chips` list (01 / 02 / 03) for benefits; straight `imageCard`s (tilt 0) for products. The camera pushes slowly on every shot. Sparse: 2–4 graphics per 20 s. No stamps, no slams, no patterns, no lock/reveal games, no film strips.
